territories.name: Perlis
territories.diagnosis: Strong internal consistency: EC Hybrid (11.8 mm/day) aligns closely with the 50-member ensemble mean (12.1 mm/day). Wide ensemble dispersion (P20–P80: 5.8–17.3 mm/day; spread 11.5 mm/day) reflects high convective uncertainty. Google WeatherNext AI Drying Window: Google DeepMind's 64-ENS (6.8 mm/day; -5.4 mm/day vs EC) resolves localized convective suppression. ⚠️ High Logistics Risk: Heavy sustained rain (11.8 mm/day, ~165 mm 14d) threatens plantation road washouts, waterlogging, and severe disruptions to Fresh Fruit Bunch (FFB) harvesting and mill evacuation.
